title: INC: Usage page delayed for Batch API jobs
author: Miles Thornton
content:
h1. INC: Usage page delayed for Batch API jobs

Status: resolved.

h1. Window
2027-03-15 02:00 UTC to 2027-03-15 11:40 UTC.

h1. Impact
Usage for Batch API jobs that finished in the window appeared on the Console usage page up to 8 hours late. Hosted API and Embeddings usage was not affected.

h1. Resolution
The batch usage writer was restarted and all delayed batch usage was backfilled by 13:00 UTC. Invoices were not affected.
